title: Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics Studies Reveal the Anticancer Potential of Medicinal-Plant-Derived Lignans as MDM2-P53 Interaction Inhibitors.
authors: Shoaib, Tagyedeen H; Abdelmoniem, Nihal; Mukhtar, Rua M; Alqhtani, Amal Th; Alalawi, Abdullah L; Alawaji, Razan; Althubyani, Mashael S; Mohamed, Shaimaa G A; Mohamed, Gamal A; Ibrahim, Sabrin R M; Hussein, Hazem G A; Alzain, Abdulrahim A
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接和MD模拟筛选植物来源木脂素作为MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂，对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The interaction between the tumor suppressor protein p53 and its negative regulator, the MDM2 oncogenic protein, has gained significant attention in cancer drug discovery. In this study, 120 lignans reported from Ferula sinkiangensis and Justicia procumbens were assessed for docking simulations on the active pocket of the MDM2 crystal structure bound to Nutlin-3a. The docking analysis identified nine compounds with higher docking scores than the co-crystallized reference. Subsequent AMDET profiling revealed satisfactory pharmacokinetic and safety parameters for these natural products. Three compounds, namely, justin A, 6-hydroxy justicidin A, and 6'-hydroxy justicidin B, were selected for further investigation due to their strong binding affinities of -7.526 kcal/mol, -7.438 kcal/mol, and -7.240 kcal/mol, respectively, which surpassed the binding affinity of the reference inhibitor Nutlin-3a (-6.830 kcal/mol). To assess the stability and reliability of the binding of the candidate hits, a molecular dynamics simulation was performed over a duration of 100 ns. Remarkably, the thorough analysis demonstrated that all the hits exhibited stable molecular dynamics profiles. Based on their effective binding to MDM2, favorable pharmacokinetic properties, and molecular dynamics behavior, these compounds represent a promising starting point for further refinement. Nevertheless, it is essential to synthesize the suggested compounds and evaluate their activity through in vitro and in vivo experiments.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制蛋白p53与其负调控因子MDM2癌蛋白之间的相互作用在癌症药物研发中引起了广泛关注。本研究评估了来自新疆阿魏（Ferula sinkiangensis）和爵床（Justicia procumbens）的120种木脂素，针对与Nutlin-3a结合的MDM2晶体结构活性口袋进行了对接模拟。对接分析识别出九种化合物的对接分数高于共结晶参考配体。随后的AMDET分析显示，这些天然产物具有令人满意的药代动力学和安全性参数。其中三种化合物，即justin A、6-羟基爵床脂素A和6'-羟基爵床脂素B，因其强结合亲和力（分别为-7.526 kcal/mol、-7.438 kcal/mol和-7.240 kcal/mol）而被选作进一步研究，这些值超过了参考抑制剂Nutlin-3a（-6.830 kcal/mol）的结合亲和力。为评估候选命中化合物结合的稳定性和可靠性，进行了持续100 ns的分子动力学模拟。值得注意的是，全面分析表明所有命中化合物均表现出稳定的分子动力学特征。基于它们对MDM2的有效结合、良好的药代动力学特性和分子动力学行为，这些化合物代表了进一步优化的有前景的起点。然而，必须合成所建议的化合物，并通过体外和体内实验评估其活性。
